import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { CartPage, ProductsPage } from '../../pages';

/**
 * Draft generated by npm run explore:draft on 2026-11-08.
 * Finding: cart-increase-quantity (deterministic probe)
 * Spec: Shopping Cart: increasing quantity (docs/APP_SPEC.md)
 * Asserts the correct behaviour: it fails while the bug is present and passes once fixed.
 * Review the steps and assertions before merging.
 */
test.describe('@e2e Explored: cart', () => {
  test('Increasing quantity updates the line subtotal, total and badge (cart-increase-quantity)', async ({ page }) => {
    const cartPage = new CartPage(page);
    const productsPage = new ProductsPage(page);

    await productsPage.goto();
    await productsPage.addToCart('Mechanical Keyboard');
    await cartPage.goto();
    await cartPage.increaseQuantityButton('Mechanical Keyboard').click();
    await cartPage.increaseQuantityButton('Mechanical Keyboard').click();

    // Expected: total $269.97; badge 3
    await expect(cartPage.productRow('Mechanical Keyboard')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(cartPage.cartTotal).toHaveText('$269.97');
    await expect(cartPage.cartLink(3)).toBeVisible();
  });
});
